findings.evidence: template/scripts/integration_contour.py:367-372 calls first_record outside the try block. Only KeyError, TypeError and ValueError from parse_time are converted to JobBlocked. first_record now raises MalformedMarkerError (candidate_lifecycle.py, _trusted_records), a RuntimeError that is not caught there. The same function already uses JobBlocked for 'cannot prove when PR was admitted'.
findings.summary: A malformed trusted record now raises MalformedMarkerError out of integration_contour's candidate_admitted_at as a raw RuntimeError, not the blocked-job outcome used for other unprovable starts.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/publication_queue.py:277-284 loops over every comment and calls latest_record per row. A malformed trusted comment now raises MalformedMarkerError. The diff handles that error in _transition and worker, but not in _earlier_slot_record or _record_comment_id. design.md says malformed records are handled by 'transition reports ownership change / worker blocks', which leaves these paths uncovered.
findings.summary: _record_comment_id and its callers (_earlier_slot_record) do not handle the MalformedMarkerError that latest_record can now raise, so a damaged trusted comment aborts queue scheduling with a raw exception.
